title_patterns: We Looked Through [Large Specific Number] [Records/Trades] — Here's What We Found
The True Origin of [Historical Event]: What [Authority Group] Get Wrong
hook_patterns: Open with a single hard number before any framing ('$200k loss', '44% wiped out', '20,000 trades')
Cold-open on a direct quote or exchange between two named figures (Q&A/press format)
State the structural event flatly in first line, no adjectives ('X just did Y')
Lead with 'We looked through [dataset]' to signal original research over commentary
Open earnings/ticker rundowns by naming all covered tickers upfront before analysis
packaging_notes: Duration bifurcation: sub-90-second clips win on breaking political/policy news; 15-25 min videos win on single-topic deep dives (AI bubble, market crash mechanics) — little traction in the 5-10 min middle zone
Same-story clustering works: multiple channels covering identical event (South Korea AI bubble) each hit outlier status independently — topical timing beats originality
Specific unrounded numbers outperform rounded ones in both titles and views (20,000 trades, $200k, 44%) — precision signals credibility over hype
Congressional stock-trading accountability is a recurring high-ratio topic across news outlets and political channels — a policy/transparency angle, not a fear angle
Multi-ticker list format ('EARNINGS ALERT: TICKER, TICKER...') consistently outperforms baseline even at low absolute views — utility-style packaging works regardless of channel size
